groups.name: Code
groups.note: Only `.code-block` and `.reference-block code` are this style. A bare `<code>` is unstyled: app.css has no `code` rule, so the 20 or so that pages write bare (an activity type's key on the types list and the builder, the audit log's and data-rights requests' times, a scheduled job's cron) render in the browser's generic monospace at its own reduced size (13px in Chromium), not in `mono` at 0.875rem. A design that shows stored text inline should name `code` and have app.css give `code` this style.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: `.code-block` (stored text shown verbatim, on `header-bg`) and the reference in `.reference-block code`. `.font-mono` keeps the surrounding size.

spacing.note: app.css's --space-* scale: prefer it, and use it for the space between blocks (a page's sections, cards, a grid's gaps, a form's padding). It is not the only grid: about 50 declarations, most of them flow 01's shell, write three steps between its points as literals, since :root has no token for them. 6px (0.375rem): between crumbs and from the back chevron to its words, above the role switch, above and below the personal links' rule, a reference block's pairs on a phone, and a control's top and bottom padding (so a control is 38px). 10px (0.625rem): a nav row's and Change role's sides and icon gap, the role head's top, the brand's mark-to-word gap, a small button's and a badge's sides, the error bar's row gap on a phone, the reconnect dialog's icon-to-title gap. 12px (0.75rem, and twice calc(space-sm + space-xs), for the system pages' two gaps): the header's rule under the subtitle, an alert's and the error bar's top and bottom, a reference block on a phone, `.form-actions`' gap, a system page's icon-to-heading gap and its panel's gap, the error bar's gap, the gap between the reconnect dialog's parts, a control's sides, the Menu toggle's, a phone nav row's and a phone switch's sides, the role head's foot. Flow 03 adds it inside rows and controls: a locked section's head row (12px by 24px), the check line's top and bottom, an instrument link's sides and a folded history row's padding. Singles: 2px under a nav group's heading, 14px (Sign in's sides, the phone role head's foot), 20px (the reconnect dialog's padding on a phone), 40px (the account card's padding).
